items.quote: Zahlbar 14 Tage nach Rechnungsdatum per Überweisung.
items.computation: Anchor is the invoice date 21.11.2026 (Saturday), a date set by a private company, so §§ 187, 188, 193 BGB apply (not deemed-delivery rules, which only apply to authorities). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event (21.11.2026) is not counted; counting starts 22.11.2026. 14 days later (§ 188 Abs. 1 BGB) falls on 05.12.2026, a Saturday. Under § 193 BGB, since the obligation is a declaration/payment expected on a Saturday, the deadline shifts to the next business day, Monday 07.12.2026.

warnings: The letter contains an unusual note about a 'Telefonhotline' maintenance outage and a separate 'Zeichen' (AP-8583-631) unrelated to the invoice itself or its stated reference (Rechnungsnummer HP-1121) — this is unusual filler for a simple dog-school invoice and worth a second look, though it does not address an AI or ask for anything unusual.

The IBAN given (DE10 3705 0198 0005 5491 20) is well-formed and German, but a valid IBAN does not prove who owns the account; verify the payee name shown by your bank's mandatory name-check before paying.
